topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I met my childhood best friend today, after years of not seeing each other. The world had quietly shifted around us, each of us charting our own paths. Despite the years, I approached with a familiar warmth, eager to reconnect. Yet, in those first moments, I noticed a puzzled look, a slight hesitation. It dawned on me slowly, a gentle realization. They didn’t remember me. I didn’t let the quiet surprise show. Instead, I smiled, introducing myself as if for the first time. We talked about old places and new beginnings, the conversation flowing easily. It was like stepping into a comfortable old shoe, even if it felt a bit different. By the end, it didn’t matter who remembered what; we were just two old souls catching up, and that was enough.
